name: draw-track-long
description: Watch-list 7's prescribed remedy: 'the dial is track length, never the card text'. The Draw Worker is the only Worker that refunds its own fee, so it has no natural brake; this lengthens its Working Week from two paying spaces to three, matching the other four. Draw 3 keep 2 is untouched, deliberately - a Worker priced in cards must over-deliver cards to be worth renting.
